phases.message: Primeline won't release our $48,600 retainage on Harbor Point until the closeout package is complete. Start here: read the terms on final payment, waivers, insurance and warranties, and our closeout checklist.
Now Sitegrid: the closeout spec sections, our submittals and startup reports, and the record drawings we uploaded.
This is Partsmith. Their lien waivers to us and the warranty registrations they filed.
And our Docshelf: our own waivers, the insurance certificates, the surety consent, the affidavit, training and attic stock records.
Back in Primeline. Attach the right document to every checklist item that still needs one. Then tell me what you left alone and why.

terms.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Primeline GC, subcontractor portal for the Harbor Point Library. Subcontract PL-2307 with Brookhollow Mechanical LLC (plumbing and HVAC). Topics: contract, final-payment, waivers, insurance, warranties. Substantial completion was certified on 25 September 2026. Attach one document at a time to a closeout checklist item; Primeline forwards the package to the architect.

Subcontract PL-2307 incorporates by reference AIA Document A201-2017, General Conditions of the Contract for Construction, as it forms part of the prime contract between the Harbor Point Library District and Primeline Builders, and binds Brookhollow to Primeline as Primeline is bound to the owner. A201-2017 is a published standard form; the clauses relied on are summarized here in Primeline's words, not quoted. Section 01 77 00 of the specifications lists the closeout submittals.

Final payment (A201-2017 section 9.10, summarized, applied by Subcontract section 9.4): Brookhollow's final payment, which is its retainage of $48,600.00, is not due until every item on its closeout checklist is accepted. Section 9.10.2 asks, in substance, for an affidavit that the bills for the work are paid, a certificate that the insurance required after final payment is in force, the surety's consent, the special warranties, and releases or waivers of liens; the specifications add the record drawings, the operation and maintenance manuals and the owner's receipts. An item already accepted is not attached again.

With the closeout package Primeline takes a conditional waiver and release on final payment from Brookhollow and from each lower-tier subcontractor and supplier, for the final amount: it releases everything once the final payment is received. A progress waiver releases only the payments up to its date and does not answer a final-waiver item. An unconditional final waiver is given after payment, not before.

The subcontract requires completed-operations coverage to stay in force for two years after final payment. The certificate attached must show a policy period that includes today; an expired certificate does not answer the item.

Warranties are documented for the equipment and products actually installed: the manufacturer's warranty for each unit, by serial number, registered to the owner; and the operation and maintenance manual for the model actually installed under its approved submittal, not a model that was substituted out. A document for equipment on another job does not answer the item.

specs.title: Closeout procedures
specs.text: Before the final application for payment, each subcontractor submits through the general contractor the items on its closeout checklist: final conditional lien waivers from itself and from every lower-tier subcontractor and supplier, an affidavit of payment of debts and claims, a current certificate of insurance, the surety's consent, warranties, operation and maintenance manuals, record drawings, the training record and the attic stock receipt.

specs.title: Project record documents
specs.text: Record drawings show the work as built. Submit the final record set, complete, issued for record and signed by the subcontractor's project manager. Working markups and drafts are not record drawings.

specs.title: Extra stock materials
specs.text: Deliver the attic stock listed in each section to the owner's facilities staff and submit their signed receipt. A delivery ticket that the owner has not signed is not a receipt. Plumbing and HVAC: 24 filters and 2 fan belts.

specs.title: Plumbing fixtures
specs.text: Lavatory faucets: as scheduled, or an approved substitution. Submit the manufacturer's operation and maintenance manual for the faucet model installed.

specs.title: Packaged rooftop units
specs.text: Two units, RTU-1 and RTU-2. The manufacturer's 5-year compressor warranty, registered to the owner, for each unit by serial number, from the day of startup.

submittals.title: Lavatory faucets
submittals.note: Fixturely FX-3100 substituted for the scheduled FX-3000, which Fixturely discontinued. All 18 faucets installed are FX-3100.
